description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/Listing/SaveAutolist. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Saves a bulk/autolist publication batch. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when the user wants to queue multiple source URLs for publication or review through the autolist/bulk listing flow. Input: data: SaveAutolistRequest. Main fields: listings: string[][], listFrequencyMinutes: int, dontListUntil: DateTime?, reviewBeforePublishing: bool, createdBy: int, ignoreVero: bool, ignoreOOS: bool, optimizeTitle: bool, optimizeDescription: bool, optimizeFields: bool, publishVariations: bool, WeListForYou: bool, GeneratorId: int?. Each listings row is [sourceUrl] or [sourceUrl, optionalTitle]. sourceUrl is required; an omitted, null or empty title means no custom title is supplied. A supplied title is preserved. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. UserDevice is optional HGRWeb client telemetry; AI chat and MCP must omit it and must not invent a device value. Output: Creates bulk listing jobs and returns an AutolistSummaryViewModel with processed, duplicated, invalid and quota-related counts. Search terms: listing saveautolist. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.
